title: Family Health Groups & Shared Household Credit Limits

intro.title: Family Health Groups & Shared Credit
intro.subtitle: Unite household members, shared Khata ceilings, primary payers, and unified billing

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 6, Part 2: Family Health Groups and Shared Household Credit Limits. Grouping related patients under a single family account simplifies credit tracking and household prescription management.
Go to Customers and select Family Groups. The left sidebar lists existing family accounts alongside active member counts and total household credit limits.
Click Create Group. Enter the household name, such as Sharma Family, and define a unified maximum shared credit ceiling across all members.
Open the group details and click Add Member. Link individual family members, select their relationship like Spouse or Child, and designate the Primary Payer responsible for billing settlements.
At the POS counter, purchases by any family member automatically draw from the shared credit balance, preventing duplicate credit risk. In Part 3, we configure Pharmacy Loyalty Rewards!

outro.takeaway: Family Health Groups: Combine household accounts under a single credit ceiling with designated primary payers for seamless community pharmacy billing.
